cases.name: focus_selection_oldest_membership
assertions: oldest member preferred focus is selected deterministically
off-focus token requests fail closed with focus_mismatch

cases.name: session_focus_no_split_brain
assertions: session_focus is write-once for the call lifecycle
second focus writer receives session_focus_already_committed
unavailable local focus surfaces focus_unavailable_for_client

cases.name: token_exchange_minimal
assertions: token exchange operation id remains ck.self.call.media.exchange.issue_token
participant_binding scheme remains ck.media.participant_binding.v1
media token TTL is positive and no greater than 600 seconds

cases.name: token_issuer_unauthorised
assertions: issuer kid must be anchored to ck.realm.media_service.service_id
rogue issuer kids fail closed with token_issuer_unauthorised

cases.name: participant_binding_required
assertions: participant_binding carries all nine required tuple fields
scheme mismatches fail participant_binding validation
Ed25519 signature covers the canonical seven-field signing input

cases.name: unknown_type_fail_closed
assertions: known media backend type labels are accepted
unknown media backend type labels fail closed with unknown_focus_type

cases.name: e2ee_key_source
assertions: SFrame frame keys use the ck-rtc-frame-key/v1 exporter label
backend-cloud key escrow is rejected
canonical six-field Context changes the derived frame key

cases.name: participant_identity_unrecognised
assertions: backend-signalled participant identities must match ck.call.state.participants
unknown rtc_participant identities fail closed with participant_identity_unrecognised

cases.name: recording_artifact_via_cokret_blob
assertions: recording egress lands on a Arkret blob endpoint
direct S3, GCS, or arbitrary HTTP recording endpoints fail closed

cases.name: recording_exporter_label
assertions: recording artifacts use the ck-rtc-recording-key/v1 exporter label
SFrame or transcript labels are rejected for recording artifact encryption
the recording exporter Context binds realm_id, call_id, focus_id, recording_id, media_service_did, and recording_start_event_id
